costs.spread: actual side-correct bid/ask captured in fills

multiple_testing.registered_candidate_equivalent_denomina: number of ADMITTED_EXECUTABLE V2 trials actually evaluated on data; rejected-pre-outcome specs are never evaluated and never inflate the denominator; capped at the inherited ceiling of 1200

seed_policy: all randomness seeded by a frozen per-model integer seed; no wall-clock
split_justification: Discovery uses only the already-inspected 2015-2017 development region. The untouched 2018-2019 holdout is partitioned into three strictly later, non-overlapping windows (2018-H1, 2018-H2, 2019) giving independent confirmation, validation and replication. No window boundary is a function of any observed outcome.

discovery.purpose: search + anti-overfitting; produces exploratory survivor set only

internal_confirmation.purpose: first strictly-out-of-sample confirmation of survivor predicate

walk_forward.discovery_train_min_bars: >= 12 months of M1 within development region
